subject: integration
name: Orivon's EthFS node
summary: Reads and stores EthFS files on Ethereum. A read finds the File in the FileStore at its fixed address and holds every chunk against the address that names it, so a wrong byte is refused; chain answers come from the Ethereum code the person chose (judged on its own row). A store is signed by the wallet after a sheet that says the files are public for ever, then sent in order as the wallet returned it. It opens no connection, holds no key and runs no outside code. Level 4. Judged here by its publisher.
